name: Ar Razy Fathan Rabbani
description: Ar Razy Fathan Rabbani is a Mobile Engineer in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, building Android and cross-platform products with Kotlin, Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, and Flutter since 2022.
summary: I build dependable Android and cross-platform products for public services, connected communities, and everyday tools. Since 2022, I have worked across Kotlin, Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, and Flutter, turning product requirements into maintainable mobile experiences with teams and independent clients.

description.paragraph: I work as an Android Engineer in the Digital Solutions division. I am involved in the development of various applications, which range from product-based to project-based. My primary focus is on developing project-based applications for government entities, with the aim of enhancing their productivity.
bullets: Collaborated with a team of developers to design and implement Android applications, ensuring optimal performance and user experience
Developed and maintained code for new features, enhancements, and bug fixes in alignment with project requirements
Worked closely with UX/UI designers to implement visually appealing and intuitive interfaces
Stayed current with the latest Android development trends and technologies, integrating them into projects for continuous improvement.

description.paragraph: As a freelance Android Developer, I work independently to design, develop, and maintain Android applications for various clients. I focus on building high-quality, user-friendly, and scalable mobile solutions tailored to clients needs.
bullets: Designed and implemented Android applications, ensuring optimal performance and smooth user experience.
Developed and maintained features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on project requirements.
Worked closely with clients to understand their needs and translate them into functional mobile applications.
Stayed up to date with the latest Android development trends and best practices to deliver cutting-edge solutions.

projects.title: Obscurenv
projects.description: A self-hosted, zero-knowledge encrypted .env storage service with a Go REST API and CLI that keeps encryption and decryption local.

projects.title: Obscurenv Web
projects.description: A self-hosted web dashboard for managing Obscurenv projects and encrypted .env files, with local browser decryption and passkey authentication.

projects.title: KBBI
projects.description: An Android dictionary application for searching Indonesian words and exploring KBBI definitions.

projects.title: KBBI Multiplatform
projects.description: An Indonesian dictionary should feel consistent on every device without maintaining four separate product implementations.
highlights: Designed shared search, word details, bookmarks, and history, then built the interface and data layers with Kotlin and Compose Multiplatform.
Created one reusable product foundation that keeps core behavior aligned across Android, iOS, web, and desktop.

projects.title: Astro CV
projects.description: A fast, print-friendly CV website built with Astro, with resume content driven by a typed JSON data model.

projects.title: JakLingko App
projects.description: Jakarta commuters need a reliable mobile touchpoint for a public transport network that connects multiple modes and payment journeys.
highlights: Contributed production Android features across NFC, maps, local persistence, and asynchronous flows in an established Kotlin and Java codebase.
Helped support a public-facing mobility product where dependable device integration and clear user flows are essential.

projects.title: Kosmo Kominfo
projects.description: Kosmo Kominfo is a productivity companion app designed for the members of the Ministry of Communication and Informatics.

projects.title: Notes Agent ( Voice to Text )
projects.description: This app assists agents in creating notes using voice-to-text technology, allowing them to transcribe their thoughts either in real time or from recordings.

projects.title: Lerun
projects.description: Lerun is a running tracking application based on modern Android tech-stacks and MVVM architecture.

projects.title: BeVoucher - Berau Coal HSE Automation
projects.description: Implemented a voucher system that enhances user experience by offering additional benefits and rewards, driving user engagement and loyalty within the app.

projects.title: Panic Button
projects.description: This app enables agents to quickly send emergency alerts or SOS messages, along with their current location, text, and video. It is designed to provide a swift and reliable way to communicate urgent situations, ensuring that help can be dispatched promptly.

projects.title: HiiGeek
projects.description: GIK UGM needed one mobile experience for a creative ecosystem spanning students, lecturers, industry professionals, artists, and the public sector.
highlights: Built cross-platform product flows for Android and iOS with Flutter, Bloc, and Firebase, translating a broad community brief into maintainable features.
Established a shared mobile experience that brings the hub's varied participants into one product surface.
